title: TarotSpreadDefinition
description: Formal specification for a reusable tarot spread template, defining positions, visual layout coordinates, deck constraints, and positional relationships.

@context.title: JSON-LD Context URL
@context.description: Optional JSON-LD context URL for Schema.org semantic interoperability and graph expansion.

@type.title: Schema.org Type
@type.description: Schema.org entity classification corresponding to an authoritative spread template.

schemaVersion.title: Specification Version
schemaVersion.description: Semantic specification version of the TarotSpreadDefinition schema.

id.title: Spread Identifier
id.description: Unique URL-safe kebab-case identifier for this spread template.

name.title: Spread Name
name.description: Human-readable display name of the spread.

summary.title: Spread Summary
summary.description: Concise single-sentence summary of the spread's purpose, inquiry scope, and general application.
examples: Classic 3-card linear temporal progression mapping development over time.

layoutType.title: Geometric Layout Type
layoutType.description: Spatial geometric layout arrangement of the card positions on a board.

difficulty.title: Difficulty Level
difficulty.description: Recommended practitioner experience level necessary to synthesize this spread.

author.title: Creator or Tradition
author.description: Author, originator, or traditional historical lineage of this spread design.

license.title: Documentation License
license.description: Open content license governing the spread layout text and position descriptions.

tags.title: Topical Tags
tags.description: Searchable categorical tags characterizing this spread's application domains.

instructions.title: Practitioner Instructions
instructions.description: Step-by-step guidance covering preparation, shuffling, drawing, and interpretive synthesis.

deckContract.title: Deck Contract Constraints
deckContract.description: Rules specifying the minimum tarot deck composition and reversal support needed for this spread.

readingVariants.title: Alternative Reading Variants
readingVariants.description: Alternative thematic lenses or role remappings that can be applied to this physical layout.

slots.title: Spread Slots
slots.description: Ordered sequence of card positions composing the spread.

hasDefinedTerm.title: Schema.org Defined Terms (Slots)
hasDefinedTerm.description: Schema.org DefinedTermSet mapping equivalent to slots for semantic consumers.

relations.title: Card Relationships
relations.description: Directed semantic relationships connecting pairs of card positions.

elementalDignity.title: Elemental Dignity Configuration
elementalDignity.description: Local rules governing elemental compatibility calculations across adjacent slots.

instructions.title: SpreadInstructions
instructions.description: Procedural ritual and analytical instructions for performing the spread.

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.description: Pre-shuffle centering, query refinement, and intention formulation guidance.
examples: Sit quietly and center your thoughts on the specific question.

shuffle.title: Shuffling
shuffle.description: Card shuffling protocol and selection procedure.
examples: Shuffle three times while holding the query in mind, then cut the deck into three piles.

drawing.title: Drawing Procedure
drawing.description: Order and spatial placement instructions for laying out cards.
examples: Draw from left to right, placing cards face down in slots 1, 2, and 3 before revealing.

synthesis.title: Interpretive Synthesis
synthesis.description: Instructions for weaving the individual slot meanings into an integrated holistic narrative.
examples: Examine the trajectory from past roots to present circumstances before analyzing the outcome.

readingVariant.title: ReadingVariantDefinition
readingVariant.description: Alternative interpretive framing overriding slot roles for an existing spatial layout.

id.title: Variant Identifier
id.description: Unique URL-safe kebab-case identifier for this variant.

name.title: Variant Name
name.description: Display name of the reading variant.

description.title: Variant Description
description.description: Detailed explanation of this variant's inquiry paradigm.
examples: Reinterprets the three linear slots as holistic personal dimensions.

slotOverrides.title: Slot Overrides
slotOverrides.description: Collection of slot redefinitions overriding default roles.

slotId.title: Target Slot Identifier
slotId.description: ID of the slot being overridden.

role.title: Overridden Role Title
role.description: New interpretive role assigned to this slot under this variant.

description.title: Overridden Role Description
description.description: Specific meaning of the slot under this variant.
examples: Cognitive clarity and conscious thought patterns.

elementalDignityRule.title: ElementalDignityRuleDefinition
elementalDignityRule.description: Rules for calculating elemental affinities between cards in adjacent spread slots.

enabled.title: Enable Elemental Dignities
enabled.description: Whether elemental dignity calculations should be performed.

notes.title: Notes
examples: Fire and Water weaken each other; Fire and Air strengthen each other.

layoutCoordinate.title: LayoutCoordinatesDefinition
layoutCoordinate.description: Normalized visual placement coordinates and rotation for positioning cards in a visual board canvas.

x.title: Horizontal Coordinate (X)
x.description: Normalized horizontal center coordinate of the card slot relative to the spread layout canvas.
x.$comment: Normalized 0.0..1.0 when coordinateSystem is 'normalized'. Not pixels. (0.0 = left edge, 1.0 = right edge).

y.title: Vertical Coordinate (Y)
y.description: Normalized vertical center coordinate of the card slot relative to the spread layout canvas.
y.$comment: Normalized 0.0..1.0 when coordinateSystem is 'normalized'. Not pixels. (0.0 = top edge, 1.0 = bottom edge).

rotation.title: Rotation Angle
rotation.description: Clockwise rotation angle in degrees for rendering card orientation (e.g., 90 degrees for crossed cards).

zIndex.title: Z-Index Stacking Order
zIndex.description: Relative vertical stacking layer index for overlapping or superimposed cards.

deckContract.title: DeckContractDefinition
deckContract.description: Rules specifying the minimum physical or virtual tarot deck composition needed to deal the spread.

minCards.title: Minimum Cards Required
minCards.description: Minimum count of distinct physical or digital cards needed in the deck to deal the spread.

maxCards.title: Maximum Cards Allowed
maxCards.description: Upper bound on drawn cards if optional clarifiers or expansion draws are allowed.

deckType.title: Compatible Deck Type
deckType.description: Deck structure standard or category suitable for executing the spread.

allowReversals.title: Allow Inverted Orientations
allowReversals.description: Whether inverted or reversed card orientations are recognized and assigned distinct meanings.

requiresSignificator.title: Requires Significator
requiresSignificator.description: Whether an intentional significator card must be isolated prior to shuffling and drawing.

cardConstraint.title: CardFilterConstraintDefinition
cardConstraint.description: Subdeck filtering rules restricting which cards are eligible to be dealt into a slot.

allowedArcana.title: Allowed Arcana Category
allowedArcana.description: Subdivision of the deck permissible for placement in this slot.

allowedSuits.title: Allowed Suits
allowedSuits.description: Specific elemental suits permitted to occupy this slot.

items.title: Suit
items.description: One of the four traditional tarot suits.

fixedCard.title: Fixed Required Card
fixedCard.description: Specific canonical card identifier required to occupy this slot (e.g. 'major-00-the-fool').

relation.title: SlotRelationDefinition
relation.description: Directed or symmetrical semantic relationship edge connecting two card positions in a spread graph.

source.title: Source Slot Identifier
source.description: Slot ID identifying the origin node in the relation edge.

target.title: Target Slot Identifier
target.description: Slot ID identifying the destination node in the relation edge.

type.title: Relationship Type
type.description: Semantic modality describing how the source card affects or interacts with the target card.

label.title: Relationship Label
label.description: Optional human-readable label or description explaining the dynamic between the slots.

weight.title: Relationship Significance Weight
weight.description: Normalized scalar indicating relative analytical weight in synthesis (1.0 = standard significance).

slot.title: SlotDefinition
slot.description: Definition of an individual card position within a spread, including its order, interpretive role, spatial layout, and deck constraints.

id.title: Slot Identifier
id.description: Unique URL-safe kebab-case identifier for this position within the spread.

order.title: Draw and Placement Order
order.description: 1-indexed continuous sequence indicating the order in which this card is drawn and laid out.

role.title: Positional Role Title
role.description: Concise interpretive label designating the query facet represented by this card.

description.title: Role Description
description.description: Detailed explanation of what this card slot represents in the context of the query and synthesis.
examples: Events, emotional baggage, or ingrained beliefs that shaped the current situation.
The primary challenge or unexpected hurdle confronting the querent.

keywords.title: Thematic Keywords
keywords.description: Quick associative keywords characterizing the energy of this slot.

layout.title: Slot Layout Coordinates
layout.description: Visual canvas coordinates and rotation angle for rendering this slot.

cardConstraint.title: Slot Card Filtering Constraints
cardConstraint.description: Subdeck filtering rules restricting which cards are eligible to be dealt into this slot.
